stages.surface_label: News UK Times ExplorAItion / Electric Twin customer-vendor deployment, 27 April 2026
stages.note: First-party News UK and Electric Twin launch records describe an organization-level synthetic-audience deployment. Neither source identifies Ben Warner or a No. 10 colleague as a participant, and the stage does not establish method origin, transfer, replacement of all consultation, accuracy, privacy compliance, coordination, or motive.

chains.why_no_hop: No bounded surface carries shared Matt Clifford co-participation across these stages. The Detachment 201 program stage is organization-level context; its separate exact-date four-officer commissioning surface does not include Clifford. The No. 10 stage is a dated Ben Warner role observation, and the later News UK stage is an organization-only customer-vendor deployment. The chain remains a chronology for further testing rather than proof of procurement, co-presence across stages, method origin, transfer, motive, wrongdoing, coordination, or common purpose.
